description:
How real products are named: pattern shares with examples, TLDs, domain styles, length and
syllables, a per-category table and highlights such as the share of AI tools on .ai. Takes
search_names' filters for one slice. Use it before proposing names.

category.description: Comma-separated categories (OR) to summarise, e.g. "AI tools".

length.description: Letters in the name - a number or a range like 4-6.

startsWith.description: Letters the name starts with, or vowel or consonant.

name: name_patterns
title: Get naming pattern statistics
